name: release
description: Cut a release: prechecks, notes, version bump, pull request, merge, tag, publish

interface.shortDescription: One release, one step at a time, stopping at the first refusal
interface.longDescription: Run the steps a release takes, in order, from what the repository declares in .releasetools.yaml: the prechecks that have to pass, the changelog entry, the version bump through the command the project declares, the pull request and its checks, the merge, the wait for the merged commit to go green, and the tag that publishes. Every step is one command whose output is read before the next one runs, and the first refusal stops the release rather than being worked around.
capabilities: Run a release's steps in order, stopping at the first refusal
Bump the version with the command the project declares
Tag only a commit whose checks already passed
defaultPrompt: Cut a release of this repository.
Ship 0.4.0 and wait for it to publish.
